I am a mother of a child in the system. I haven’t been able to speak to my son in over 2 weeks! He was taken from me while we were living in my car. He’s been in several hospitals and mental institutions. And within 2 weeks was transferred from 1 foster home to another. Before he was taken by them, I asked them to take him. He has a history of violence and is on probation. So, no homeless shelter would accept him there. Then, DHR went after me for ‘abandonment, mental abuse, and choosing to be homeless’ with my child. I asked them for help several times. I could write a book about all of my experiences with them. The only way I could get my son into the mental health organizations that could be of help to him, was through DHR. But, instead of listening to my pleas, they turned on me. They spat lies. Gave me a lawyer that doesn’t even care about any of this situation. I’ve asked for help with a therapist and help finding a place to live and many agreements have been made that haven’t held up. If I could be any help at all, I can formally write down everything I’ve gone through verbatim. Anything at all. Our children are NOT being taken care of the way that they should be.

Tommy Tuberville can fix this. And everything else backwards about Alabama. Vote Tommy T.
